_readme: Contributions that are in main but whose pull request does not carry GitHub's merged badge.
List them here by pull request number, with the commits that landed, so the generator credits them.
The contributor's identity is read from the GitHub API, not stored here.
Check that every commit is in main (git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main) before adding it; CONTRIBUTORS.md states this publicly.

landed_without_merged_badge.note: Five of its six changes landed through #69, one commit each with a Co-authored-by trailer.
Its declared size test helper landed through #69; the fix itself duplicated #58, which landed first.
